You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.

Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback read got 0xff (all-ones idle) instead of 0xa5, triggering FAIL 0xdead TRAP uart data mismatch. After reset TX is busy with the 15-bit power-on dummy (send_dummy=1, send_bitcnt=15). The extra `if (reg_div_we) send_dummy <= 1` re-arms send_dummy on divider programming, so when the first dummy ends a second dummy starts and blocks `reg_dat_we && !send_bitcnt`, dropping 0xa5 and leaving ser_tx idle at 1.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash d36f17644755dba0 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
